none: PAS NLM-254D14: Roman Coin: Radiate fraction from near Market Rasen
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate fraction, unknown emperor, possibly issue of 260-270, Reece period 13. One third of flan lost. Obverse description: Radiate head left; lacks the hirstute appearance of Gallic empire rulers from what is visible. Obverse inscription: [--]B S [--]. Reverse description: Sacrificial implements. Reverse inscription: [PI]ET[AS AVG]. Diameter (in excess of): 16.1mm, Weight:…
